Doc docs/delivery/changes/CR-20260913-nen-tang-da-nguoi-dung.md (dac biet Nhom A-F, luong UI muc 6.1) va phan cuoi docs/exchanges/2026-09-13.md (vong coaching Q12-Q21 + phien Council vua roi rut gon danh sach man/popup xuong con: 5 trang moi [Chon team & vai tro, Dang cho duyet, Khu quan tri voi 7 khu con (Teams&Leader, Bang hien thi chuc nang, Vai dac biet, URL Redmine, Nhat ky Admin, Nguoi cho duyet, Nguoi dung), Quan ly team Leader voi 3 tab (Thanh vien, Nhat ky, Cau hinh bao cao), Lich release chung]; 4 popup moi [Da cap team/vai tro, Canh bao bot thanh vien, Tao team moi, Yeu cau mo khoa]; 2 component loi dung chung [popup mat quyen FR-4a voi 2 nhanh, component 409]; 6 inline bo sung [loc chi task cua toi, ep gio chung, duyet mo khoa inline, checklist ca nhan release, cong tac rieng tu Mind Map, deep-link FR-9a]; 3 man sua [Bao cao tuan, Cai dat Member, popup sua task Project]).

Nhiem vu: dung tren quan diem TUNG ROLE rieng (Admin, Leader thuong/team phat trien, Leader team dieu phoi release, Member) roi di qua tung hanh dong CHINH ho can lam (tra cuu tung FR/AC lien quan role do trong CR that, khong doan) de danh gia xem voi bo man/popup hien tai, ho co DE HIEU DE DUNG khong. Cu the:

1. **Member**: hanh trinh dang nhap lan dau -> cho duyet -> lam viec (task ca nhan, sua ho so project cua minh, gui bao cao). Co buoc nao roi vao ngo cut, khong biet lam gi tiep, hoac phai doan y nghia (vd trang thai pending hien gi, co ro rang la dang cho khong)?

2. **Leader (team phat trien thuong)**: quan ly team (them/bot nguoi, mau Gantt), dang ky lich release cua team minh, xem lich chung phat hien trung, xem bao cao tuan, cau hinh bao cao. Voi 3 tab gon trong 1 man 'Quan ly team', nguoi dung co de tim dung tab can khong hay bi roi giua cac tab khong lien quan nhau (thanh vien/nhat ky/bao cao la 3 chu de rat khac nhau de chung 1 man)?

3. **Leader team dieu phoi release**: ngoai viec cua Leader thuong, con phai: khoa lich, duyet yeu cau mo khoa, ep gio chung khi qua han, sinh bai thong bao gop. Cac hanh dong nay nam ranh rai o dau (Lich release chung? tab Cau hinh dot?) - co ro rang thu tu thao tac khong, hay phai nhay qua lai nhieu cho?

4. **Admin**: duyet nguoi cho tham gia, cau hinh 7 khu trong 1 trang quan tri, xu ly khi team dieu phoi mat Leader (nhan thong bao FR-9a roi phai lam gi tiep - co deep-link dung cho khong). Voi 7 khu con don vao 1 sidebar, co qua tai/kho tim khong?

Cho tung role: liet ke cu the buoc nao (neu co) dang KHO HIEU/KHO DUNG, va de xuat sua thiet ke ro rang (doi vi tri, doi nhan nut, gop/tach lai, hay them dieu huong ro hon). Neu khong tim thay van de gi thuc su dang ke thi tra loi PASS cho role do, dung bay ra van de gia cho co.
